xna-type.name: SamplerState
xna-type.summary: Contains sampler states for the device.

constructor.summary: Initializes a new instance of the sampler state class.

property.name: AddressU
property.summary: Gets or sets the texture-address mode for the u-coordinate.

property.name: AddressV
property.summary: Gets or sets the texture-address mode for the v-coordinate.

property.name: AddressW
property.summary: Gets or sets the texture-address mode for the w-coordinate.

property.name: BorderColor
property.summary: Gets or sets the border color.

property.name: Filter
property.summary: Gets or sets the type of filtering during sampling.

property.name: MagFilter
property.summary: Gets or sets a magnification filter.

property.name: MaxAnisotropy
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum anisotropy. The default value is 0.

property.name: MaxMipLevel
property.summary: Gets or sets the level of detail (LOD) index of the largest map to use.

property.name: MinFilter
property.summary: Gets or sets a minification filter.

property.name: MipFilter
property.summary: Gets or sets a mipmap filter to use during minification.

property.name: MipMapLevelOfDetailBias
property.summary: Gets or sets the mipmap level of detail (LOD) bias. The default value is 0.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

overload.summary: Immediately releases the unmanaged resources used by this object.

parameters.parameter: [ MarshalAsAttribute (U1)] true to release both managed and unmanaged resources; false to release only unmanaged resources.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

field.name: AnisotropicClamp
field.summary: Contains default state for anisotropic filtering and texture coordinate clamping.
field.remarks: Thisbuilt-in state object has the following settings: Filter = TextureFilter.Anisotropic, AddressU = TextureAddressMode.Clamp, AddressV = TextureAddressMode.Clamp, AddressW = TextureAddressMode.Clamp,

field.name: AnisotropicWrap
field.summary: Contains default state for anisotropic filtering and texture coordinate wrapping.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: Filter = TextureFilter.Anisotropic, AddressU = TextureAddressMode.Wrap, AddressV = TextureAddressMode.Wrap, AddressW = TextureAddressMode.Wrap,

field.name: LinearClamp
field.summary: Contains default state for linear filtering and texture coordinate clamping.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: Filter = TextureFilter.Linear, AddressU = TextureAddressMode.Clamp, AddressV = TextureAddressMode.Clamp, AddressW = TextureAddressMode.Clamp,

field.name: LinearWrap
field.summary: Contains default state for linear filtering and texture coordinate wrapping.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: Filter = TextureFilter.Linear, AddressU = TextureAddressMode.Wrap, AddressV = TextureAddressMode.Wrap, AddressW = TextureAddressMode.Wrap,

field.name: PointClamp
field.summary: Contains default state for point filtering and texture coordinate clamping.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: Filter = TextureFilter.Point, AddressU = TextureAddressMode.Clamp, AddressV = TextureAddressMode.Clamp, AddressW = TextureAddressMode.Clamp,

field.name: PointWrap
field.summary: Contains default state for point filtering and texture coordinate wrapping.
field.remarks: This built-in state object has the following settings: Filter = TextureFilter.Point, AddressU = TextureAddressMode.Wrap, AddressV = TextureAddressMode.Wrap, AddressW = TextureAddressMode.Wrap,
